detail.title: Return
detail.gone: This return is no longer on the phone.
detail.sentBackWhat: VK Nex keeps it as a draft; nothing has posted. Fix it (Edit) and Send again: it updates the same draft. Or Delete it here and in VK Nex.
detail.heldWhat: VK Nex keeps it as a draft for an approver. Nothing to do on the phone: it posts when the office clears it, and shows here after Sync.
detail.waitingText: Kept on this phone. Sync or Send now sends it; you can still edit or delete it.
detail.sendTried: Sent once without an answer: it goes again with the same id, so VK Nex never makes it twice.
detail.oldText: A free return from the earlier screens, without a reason from VK Nex: it is never sent. Delete it and make it again if the goods came back.
detail.estimateWas: Phone estimate was {{amount}}: VK Nex adds charges and the bill's discounts.
detail.officeOnly: Posted returns change only in the office (amend or cancel). This screen updates at each Sync.
detail.updates: This screen updates at each Sync.
detail.deleteText: It is removed from this phone. VK Nex never had it.
detail.deleteSentBack: It is removed from this phone and its draft is deleted in VK Nex (needs the server).
detail.deletedInOffice: The office deleted this draft. Make a new return if the goods still come back.
